claim: The sample prints its temporary location, creates three separate Git worktrees with distinct commits and one committed sample file each, runs one declared check in each, supports inspect and served-board modes, and removes the normal sample when it finishes.
sandbox: fresh integration-test process runs the public demo; inspects every kept worktree, commit, and sample file; starts and stops --serve; then asserts normal-demo cleanup

claim: The init command writes a commented, parseable configuration.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory invokes the public init command, counts explanatory comments, and parses the generated TOML

claim: By default, only this computer can open the status board at 127.0.0.1.
sandbox: fresh integration-test process invokes the public init command and inspects its generated default server address

claim: The live status page identifies a board limited to this computer and warns when another device may reach the configured address.
sandbox: fresh public watcher serves the real board first on 127.0.0.1 and then on 0.0.0.0; assert the page describes each listener accurately

claim: The CLI runs only commands you put in its config.
sandbox: fresh Git worktree and public run --once --json command; assert a declared marker exists and an undeclared marker does not

claim: The CLI adds no isolation layer: configured commands inherit its user identity, environment, filesystem access, and network access.
where: landing boundaries, README, /privacy, generated init config
sandbox: fresh Git worktree and local TCP listener; assert the configured command inherits identity and environment, writes beside the worktree, and reaches the listener

claim: The local board shows each worktree's state, commit, and changed-file count.
sandbox: fresh changed Git worktree and public run --once --json command; assert the observed status, exact commit, and changed-file count

claim: The CLI can run once for scripts or CI, print valid JSON, return meaningful PASS or FAIL exit codes, and leave no watcher running.
sandbox: fresh Git worktree; invoke passing and failing public --once --json flows, parse both outputs, count one check run, inspect exit codes, and verify the board port stays closed

claim: The watcher serves RUNNING status before initial checks, stops each command at its configured timeout, and reruns after that worktree changes.
where: README, generated init config, CLI status board
sandbox: fresh public watcher with a one-second limit and a 120-second command plus a delayed child write; assert immediate RUNNING, bounded ERROR, descendant cancellation, then PASS after a worktree change

claim: The board keeps the last passing commit when a newer check fails, and never promotes a result for a commit that changed during its check.
sandbox: fresh public watcher; commit a new verdict while its declared check sleeps, then inspect status.json for the failing new commit and retained old last_pass_commit

claim: When a worktree changes, the watcher reruns only its declared checks.
sandbox: fresh public watcher with two Git worktrees; change one and assert its check marker changes while the other marker does not

claim: The one-click ?demo=1 recording is isolated, replayable, resettable, and saves no browser data.
sandbox: fresh 390px browser context enters through the landing action, advances and resets the recording, checks the persistent banner and exits, then asserts empty storage and no service worker

claim: The documentation site sends no analytics or tracking requests.
sandbox: fresh browser context records every landing, demo, privacy, and terms request and asserts each remains same-origin

claim: npm run build creates dist/site with index.html plus built /demo, /privacy, and /terms routes.
sandbox: clean checkout runs the documented build alias, then asserts the artifact root and route-specific HTML files, titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, and social metadata
